description: For the order calculation items are applied in (SQLBI, "Avoiding pitfalls in calculation groups precedence"). One table with no rows. Measures: [Just2] = 2, [Just2Times10] = CALCULATE ( [Just2], Multiplier[Factor] = "Mul10" ). Calculation groups: Adder[Addend] (precedence 100) with Plus5 = SELECTEDMEASURE () + 5; Multiplier[Factor] (precedence 200) with Mul10 = SELECTEDMEASURE () * 10.
